repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-user
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for user identity. It registers webex.internal.user, which resolves emails and user objects to uuids through a debounced batcher and an in-memory id and email store, and wraps the identity, atlas, conversation, and SCIM calls for account verification, activation, one-time passwords, password and name updates, preferred meeting site updates, and meeting site list building.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-user package entry point
public_interfaces.audience: internal-plugin-avatar, internal-plugin-conversation, internal-plugin-team, plugin-meetings, recipe-private-web-client, and webex-server in the webex-js-sdk workspace
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package also imports the device plugin and registers User as internal plugin 'user' with config.user. buildPreferredSiteBody, buildMeetingSiteList, and SCIM_SCHEMAS are exported from src/user.js only, not from the entry point.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.user runtime methods
public_interfaces.audience: sibling SDK packages and sign-in and settings code
public_interfaces.notes: User extends WebexPlugin. Config keys under config.user: batcherWait, batcherMaxCalls, batcherMaxWait, verifyDefaults. The hasPassword property is persisted through @persist('@').

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source for this package. README.md is retained product documentation, not the behavioral authority. Request transport, retries, and token refresh are owned by the sibling package webex-core.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log or put a client secret, token, password, or one-time password in a URL or log line.
negative_guidance.why: These are credentials; the existing flows send them only in request bodies, basic auth, or the authorization header.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not return a cached uuid to a create: true caller unless the entry's userExists is truthy.
negative_guidance.why: Without create, the service can return an id for an email that has no account.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add a second uuid cache beside UserUUIDStore.
negative_guidance.why: getUUID, recordUUID, and get() all feed one store; a second cache would drift.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not reimplement request handling, retries, or token refresh here.
negative_guidance.why: They are owned by webex-core and shared with every plugin.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the list of methods or config keys.
negative_guidance.why: It describes none of them. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The owner confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config disables coverage collection.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a request-shape or behavior case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence or a guard-only test exists, for example getUserCI, the verify token fallback, the config defaults, or the faker batcher. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
